name: dnspython DNS Toolkit
free_limit: ISC-licensed Python DNS toolkit for DNS queries, zone transfers, dynamic updates, nameserver testing and record/message handling, with no software usage quota.
watch_out: This is a local Python library, not hosted DNS or a free managed DNS zone. Users supply resolvers, network access and their own infrastructure; upstream DNS services, paid providers and network traffic may have separate costs. Respect third-party DNS rate limits and policies.
